core_obligations: Unwind the definition of a compactification and settle the saturated case by the previous lemma (proof lines 8612-8620).
In the general case pass to the scheme theoretic closure and use cofilteredness to conclude (proof lines 8620-8630).
proof_roadmap: The general case via the closure (proof lines 8620-8630).
difficulty_reason: For an open immersion j : U -> X of Noetherian schemes, a compactification j' : U -> X' over X with structure morphism f : X' -> X, the lemma asserts a canonical isomorphism Rj_! -> Rf_* o R(j')_! of functors D^b_Coh(O_U) -> Pro-D^b_Coh(O_X), with the extension functors as in Remark labelled remark-extension-by-zero (statement lines 8576-8610). The proof recalls that being a compactification means exactly that f is proper, j' is an open immersion and j = f o j' by More on Flatness, Section labelled flat-section-compactify (proof lines 8612-8618). If j'(U) = f^{-1}(j(U)) the lemma follows immediately from Lemma labelled lemma-well-defined-pre; otherwise one takes X'' contained in X' to be the scheme theoretic closure of j' and j'' : U -> X'' the corresponding open immersion, giving the displayed diagram, and More on Flatness, Lemma labelled flat-lemma-compactifications-cofiltered part (c) together with the previous discussion yields the isomorphisms Rf'_* o Rj''_! = Rj'_! and R(f o f')_* o Rj''_! = Rj_!, whence R(f o f')_* = Rf_* o Rf'_* gives the result (proof lines 8620-8630). Reducing to the case where the compactification is saturated and otherwise passing to the scheme theoretic closure is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
